what_happened: On an open multi-lane highway with no vehicle ahead, the policy braked hard for no reason, from 16.9 to 5.0 m/s. By the failure it was about 21 m behind where the recorded car was, and a following car had already rear-ended it. At 7.6 s, replayed actor 28 came up from behind on the right and cut into the ego's lane, hitting its front-right corner, which the metrics count as an at-fault front collision.

On a clear multi-lane highway with no lead vehicle (the only gap reading is about 52 m or more), the policy braked hard for no visible reason, from 16.9 to 5.4 m/s after handoff. Replayed traffic coming from behind, which follows the recording and can't react, first hit the ego's rear and then hit it again at 7.6 s: actor 28 caught up and overlapped the ego's front corner while the ego sat about 0.8 m off the recorded path, about 20 m behind where the human car was.

On an open multi-lane highway with no lead vehicle closer than about 50 m, the ego braked hard for no clear reason, from 16.9 to 5.4 m/s, and fell about 21 m behind its recorded position. The replayed vehicles behind it, which do not react to the ego, caught up: one rear-ended it, and then actor 28 ran into its right front corner, which was flagged as an at-fault front collision even though the ego never ran into anything.
